```plato

    //==
    // # Plane — the former host intrinsics
    //
    // These ten bodies used to be bodiless declarations in
    // `intrinsics-planes.library.plato`, forwarded to `System.Numerics.Plane`.
    // They are ordinary Plato now, so the host contract is one file with no
    // exceptions; the trade is that generated C# no longer routes plane
    // operations through System.Numerics and loses its SIMD acceleration.
    //
    // Two conventions decide the signs below and are stated per body:
    //   * Hesse form is `Dot(Normal, p) = Distance` (this vocabulary), where
    //     System.Numerics uses `Dot(Normal, p) + D = 0`, i.e. `D = -Distance`.
    //   * Matrices multiply a ROW vector on the left, `v' = v M`
    //     (CONVENTIONS.md - Matrices), so `RowN` is the image of basis vector N.

    // A copy of the plane whose normal has unit length, with Distance divided by
    // the same factor so the point set Dot(Normal, p) = Distance is unchanged.
    // The identity when Direction3D's unit invariant holds; the repair path after
    // a non-rigid transform has broken it.
    Normalize(pl: Plane): Plane
    {
        var len = pl.Normal.Vector.Length;
        return (Direction3D(pl.Normal.Vector / len), pl.Distance / len);
    }
```
